RETURN POLICY — Boohoo UK:
• Return window: 28 days from delivery
• Return cost: £1.99 (deducted from refund) — FREE for loyalty members
• How to return: Log into boohoo.com, go to My Account > My Orders > Return Item. Attach the prepaid label and drop off at any Evri point.
• Refund timeline: 3-5 business days after we receive your item
• Non-returnable: swimwear, lingerie, pierced jewellery, beauty products (if seal broken), personalised items, sale items (unless faulty)
• Exchanges: We don't offer direct exchanges. Return for a refund and place a new order.
boohoo_uk.delivery:
DELIVERY POLICY — Boohoo UK:
• Standard delivery: 3-5 working days — £3.99 (free on orders over £35)
• Next day delivery: Order by 10pm — £5.99
• Nominated day delivery: Choose your day — £5.99
• Collection: Collect from over 900 Evri points — £2.99
• Weekend delivery: Friday-Sunday — £7.99
• International: Available to 90+ countries, rates at checkout
boohoo_uk.payment:
PAYMENT POLICY — Boohoo UK:
• We accept: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Klarna (buy now pay later), Laybuy (pay in 6 instalments), Boohoo gift cards
• Klarna: Repayment is between you and Klarna. If we issue a refund, Klarna will be notified automatically.
• Gift cards: Can be used alongside other payment methods.
